HOW TO PLAY

  • Clear every room fast — your finish time sets the multiplier.
  • Gold targets knock time off the clock. Drop them all to clear a room.
  • Red decoys add time. Missing costs nothing, so keep firing.
  • Never shoot the hostage — it is a time setback, never a loss.
  • Drag to look, tap FIRE, hold ADS, swap AR / DMR for far lanes.
